text.When I worked as a bridge SE, I was allo: Nilipofanya kazi kama daraja SE, niliruhusiwa kutumia AI yoyote niliyopenda kwenye kompyuta yangu mwenyewe.
text.It wasn't some huge company. It was more: Haikuwa kampuni kubwa. Ilikuwa zaidi ya mwanzo, na rais alikuwa aina ya kusema "tutumie AI."
text.So I paid for it, and every week I made: Kwa hivyo nililipa, na kila wiki nilifanya kitu kazini kuwa bora zaidi. Hiyo ilikuwa furaha ya kweli.
text.The one I liked most was making the meet: Nilipenda zaidi ni kuandaa kumbukumbu za mkutano.
text.At the start, writing up the minutes of: Mwanzoni, kuandika kumbukumbu za mkutano zilizotumiwa kunichukua saa 1, wakati mwingine 2 saa.
text.The good thing about Gemini is that it h: Jambo zuri kuhusu Gemini ni kwamba inashughulikia media titika, kwa hiyo ina nguvu na picha na sauti, si maandishi tu.
text.So when a meeting ended, I handed the mi: Kwa hiyo mkutano ulipoisha, nilikabidhi dakika kwa Gemini, nikachapa swali, na kulitoa kwa takribani dakika 1.
text.And people around me would go \"whoa, th: Na watu karibu nami wangeenda "whoa, hiyo ilikuwa haraka." Hilo lilinifurahisha.
